title: ServiceNow Climbs 5% After Denying Decagon Acquisition Interest; Salesforce Rises 4%, Palantir Dips
key_facts: ServiceNow stock was up 5% to $146.93 in midday trading on 15 Oct 2026 after it rejected reports it planned to buy Decagon
Decagon is a privately held maker of AI customer-service agents
On 14 Oct 2026 Amit Zavery, ServiceNow's president, chief product officer and chief operating officer, said ServiceNow has no interest or intention of purchasing Decagon
Zavery said the acquisition approach is unchanged and ServiceNow prioritizes organic growth
ServiceNow already sells its own agent tools (AI Control Tower, Now Assist, Build Agent)
Salesforce rose 4% and Palantir fell 0.9% the same day
quote_evidence: "We are aware of misinformation in the market today about our acquisition strategy. To be clear, ServiceNow has no interest or intention of purchasing Decagon."
ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) stock is up 5% to $146.93 in midday trading after the company rejected reports that it planned to buy Decagon.
a denial removes a rumor without adding new revenue for ServiceNow
why_it_matters_hint: A company on the record rules out buying a rival AI startup.
notes: Follow-up of the 14 Oct item (Business Insider: Decagon held early M&A talks and hired a banker). The article does not say whether that report named ServiceNow. The article also contains investor-advice wording, not used.
